explanation: The effect’s own cited article names the cause in its lead: "Immediate causes of the war in 1966 included a military coup, a counter-coup, and anti-Igbo pogroms in the Northern Region." The military coup of January 1966 is the first of the three and the only one this atlas holds; the counter-coup and the pogroms are not records here and no edge is written for them. `probable`, because the only source is Wikipedia (A2).
